content:
We have IR spectrum with peaks: 3550, 3475 (likely O-H), 3100-3069 (C-H aromatic), 1737 (C=O carbonyl), 1596,1586 (aromatic C=C). So carbonyl peak at 1737 cm-1 indicates presence of carbonyl group. Need number of carbonyl groups. IR alone may not differentiate multiple carbonyls if overlapping. But we have only one carbonyl stretch. Likely one carbonyl. Could be more but overlapping? Usually each carbonyl gives a strong peak around 1700-1750. If there were two, might see two peaks. So answer 1.

We could also check carbon NMR for carbonyl carbon shift ~200 ppm. But not needed. However to be safe, maybe verify with carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
